entries.scope: Evidence-bound reader paths for secure development container hardening
entries.rationale: The validated image identity, runtime boundaries, supply-chain blockers, platform limits, learner handoff, and safe next actions must be visible without implying approval.
audiences: First-year learners in all four binding training occupations
readerPaths: Repository status and safe quick start
Learner start, verification status, and troubleshooting
Image, Compose, mounts, ports, network, state, and shutdown
Toolchain, smoke, SBOM, vulnerability, and secret validation
entries.navigationImpact: Existing repository, learner, and operations entry points link to the dated canonical feature evidence; no new portal or external distribution is introduced.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second in each synchronized file, approximately CEFR B2, with technical terms explained at first use.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Commands and native rootless-Podman runtime were observed on macOS. Separate Windows-host and Ubuntu/WSL2-with-own-rootless-Podman evidence plus VS Code attachments remain Open. Decision DEC-XPLAT-WSL2-2026-09-04 permits shared physical Windows hardware but forbids runtime or evidence reuse and makes no native-Linux claim.
entries.risk: High; overstating platform, learner, vulnerability, secret, or approval status could turn incomplete evidence into unsafe release guidance.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Any user flow, command, mount, port, network, tool, vulnerability disposition, platform result, learner handoff, navigation, or documentation-impact change.
